Whether the third way is offered before or after the fight objective appears isn't shown; stage 120 completes on its own, with no objective after the mine.

ways.title: Kill the guard

steps: Obtain a glassfish for Zaria in Falkreath
Obtain the disguised invisibility potion from Zaria
Give the disguised invisibility potion to the guard in the Falkreath Barracks
Tell Zaria that the guard is dead

unsure.why: The note step's journal text carries the game's name tag for the Jarl ('<Alias=Jarl>'), copied as it stands; the game fills in the Jarl's name.

On the kill way, the hand-over step is placed before the kill because stage 45 (guard killed) sits between stage 40 (potion in hand, go to the barracks) and stage 50 (potion handed over); the records don't stop you killing him earlier.

evidence: objective 0 follows stage 0 log; stage 20 log 'read what the note has to say' -> objective 20; stage 30 log 'obtain the disguised potion' -> objective 30; stage 40 log 'hand it over to the guard' -> objective 40
stage 50 log 'follow him' -> objective 50; stage 70 log 'let Zaria know that the plan worked' -> objective 60
stage 45 log 'I killed the guard... I should let Zaria know' -> objective 61
